status_notes: Measured from the gatk-sv-156-smoke-test 10-sample end-to-end run.
HealthOmics per-run costs harvested via AnalyzeAHORunPerformance (resource/instance-second based, 20% headroom model) on 2026-06-03.

EC2-hybrid cost = measured m5.2xlarge on-demand rate (Singapore, $0.48/hr) x active wall-clock hours for the scramble + MakeCohortVcf + GQ chain + Phase D steps that cannot run natively on HealthOmics.
Costs exclude one-time reference-bundle S3 staging (~$5-10) and any account discounts/credits. Storage costs for sub-hour DYNAMIC runs may be slightly underestimated by the analyzer.

cost_engine.healthomics: AnalyzeAHORunPerformance manifest-based (instance-seconds x on-demand omics price, +20% headroom)
cost_engine.ec2_hybrid: m5.2xlarge Singapore on-demand $0.48/hr x active wall-clock

A_per_sample.notes: GSE dominates. Scramble = ~5h serial EC2 (~$2.40). EvidenceQC = $0.05.

B_cohort.notes: RegenotypeCNVs skipped (<100 samples). GatherBatchEvidence = $2.53 (gCNV cohort-mode dominates).

C_post_processing.notes: RefineComplexVariants on HealthOmics ($0.11). The rest on EC2 hybrid (MakeCohortVcf ~2h + GQ chain ~1.4h).

D_delivery.notes: AnnotateVcf 24-contig scatter ~12 min; MainVcfQC ~6 min. Both EC2 hybrid.

gse_per_caller_avg_usd.note: Per-sample averages across 10 samples. Manta is the single most expensive task (95%+ CPU on omics.c.4xlarge-class).

scaling_projection.method: Per-sample modules (GSE, Scramble) scale linearly; cohort modules (Phase B/C/D) are ~fixed and amortize over more samples.
scaling_projection.note: Measured 10-sample per-sample ($3.62) is already well under the $7 target because GSE ran efficiently. Larger cohorts trend toward ~$3.40/sample. The full 156-sample cohort projects to roughly $530 total.

caveats: Resource-based estimate, not settled Cost Explorer billing. Cost Explorer reflects the same instance-seconds plus EBS/data-transfer and would land within ~10%.
EC2-hybrid hours are active-compute wall-clock; the shared m5.2xlarge instance is long-lived, so true marginal cost is even lower (instance was already running).
Per-sample cost is dominated by GatherSampleEvidence ($2.85/sample); all cohort-level work adds ~$0.77/sample at n=10 and less at scale.
